title: Lab 1 - 2026

lab_objective.description: By the end of this lab, you will be able to navigate the Linux file system, manage files and directories, and use basic Linux commands to collect and organize system information.
lab_objective.scenario: You have recently joined the Linux Administration team. Your manager has asked you to become familiar with the Linux file system by collecting server information, creating directories and files, organizing data, and verifying your work using basic Linux commands.
objectives: View files and directories using different ls options.
Copy and move files between directories.
Display directory hierarchy using the tree command.
Collect server information and append it to a file.

tasks.title: Prepare the Working Environment
steps: Login to the Linux server.
Open the Terminal.
Navigate to your home directory.
Throughout this lab, append the output of each required command to a file named 'server_info' located in your home directory.

tasks.title: Display Present Working Directory
steps: Display your current working directory.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.

tasks.title: Check Linux Kernel Version
steps: Display the Linux kernel version.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.

tasks.title: Display Directory Contents
steps: Display detailed information about files in the current directory.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.
Display all files including hidden files with detailed information.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.

tasks.title: Create and Navigate Directories
steps: Create a directory named 'Linux'.
Navigate into the 'Linux' directory.
Verify your location by displaying the present working directory.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.

tasks.title: Create Subdirectories
steps: Inside the 'Linux' directory, create the following directories:
Redhat
oel
debian

tasks.title: Navigate Back to Home Directory
steps: Move one directory up.
Verify your present working directory.
Append the output to the 'server_info' file.

tasks.title: Create Empty Files
steps: Create the following empty files in your home directory:
file1.txt
pic.jpg
clip.avi

tasks.title: Create Directories and Move Files
steps: Create the following directories:
documents
images
media
Move file1.txt into the documents directory.
Move pic.jpg into the images directory.
Move clip.avi into the media directory.

tasks.title: Create Nested Directory Structure
steps: Create the directory structure office/hobby/personal using a single mkdir command with the appropriate option.

tasks.title: Copy Files
steps: Copy file1.txt from the documents directory into the office directory.
Copy pic.jpg from the images directory into the hobby directory.

tasks.title: Display Directory Tree
steps: Display the directory structure of the office directory using the tree command.
Save the output in a file named 'office_tree' located inside office/hobby/personal.

completion_message: Cool!!!! Great Job. You have successfully completed Linux Basic Commands & Navigation Lab.
